title: Audio capture · {{id}}

session.idle: The session hasn’t started. Audio still reaches the server; captions begin when an admin starts the session.
session.live: The session is live: this audio becomes captions.
session.paused: The session is paused. Audio reaches the server but isn’t transcribed.
session.error: The session stopped with an error. The admin dashboard says why.

device.label: Audio input
device.locked: Input names appear once you allow microphone access.

notice.noToken: This link has no capture token, so the server won’t accept the audio. Open the capture link from the admin dashboard.
notice.clipping: The input is clipping. Lower the mixer’s output a little.
notice.silent: No sound is reaching the server. Check that the mixer’s output is up and the right input is selected.
notice.reconnecting: The connection to the server dropped. The last few seconds of audio are kept and sent when it’s back. If this lasts, check the network, or ask the admin for a new capture link.
notice.replaced: Another capture page took over this session, and only one can send at a time.

hint: Keep this page open. The screen stays on while it sends.
